payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the candidate frog occupy the toilet bowl interior, rather than merely overlapping the opening or resting on an exterior toilet surface?
node.criteria: Pass if at least one recognizable frog is visibly situated within the bowl interior, using its body position relative to the inner rim and visible bowl surfaces as evidence. Ordinary contact with the rim by feet does not negate an otherwise clear interior placement. Fail if the relevant geometry is assessable and no frog occupies the interior; distinguish a visibly incomplete insertion from placements wholly outside the bowl. Unknown if occlusion or ambiguous compositing prevents resolving interior placement. Do not infer location solely from two-dimensional overlap.
node.binding: Use s1's candidate identification and s2's source-relative progress observations as ancestor context, but inspect the edited bowl boundary independently. Explain the candidate's body position relative to the opening, inner rim, and bowl cavity. Distinguish other frogs on the raised lid, surrounding fixtures, and floor; their presence neither proves nor negates the requested placement.
